text:
Tori: Quick heads-up: I handed in my resignation yesterday. Last day is 2026-05-01. Want to schedule a brief handoff and confirm benefits/COBRA timing.

Ben: Thanks @Tori. Per policy, active benefits end at 23:59 PT on your last day (2026-05-01). COBRA notice will be emailed within ~10 business days and you'll have a 60-day enrollment window from the date on that notice. I'll create the offboard task and link the COBRA letter to your profile. :white_check_mark:

Alexis: Can you paste a short list of priority work and any runbooks to copy? I'll pick up the rollout tasks if needed. Also want to schedule a 45min knowledge transfer session.

Tori: Priority items: PR-501 (routing fixes), infra alert for seq-length spikes (PagerDuty rule), and an eval I maintain. Runbook link: https://confluence.redwood.com/pages/tori-handoff. I can do the KT session Wed 4/22 14:00 PT. Prefer recording.

Michael: IT notes: standard deprovision timeline is SSO + Slack on last day EOD, VPN and building access disabled next morning at 09:00 by default. Long-lived API keys are rotated on deprovision; ephemeral tokens created for any post-exit fixes. If you have service accounts or robot keys, list them so we don't break infra. Quick check to run: 

```
# list tokens owned by user
redwood-cli auth tokens --owner tori --show-ids
```

Ben: Exit interview booked for 2026-05-06 at 11:00 PT. Please confirm. We'll also include a short separation survey link in the calendar invite.

Tori: Confirmed 5/06 11:00. Also planning to drop laptop at HQ mailroom and return keycard on last Friday. Can you open a shipping label for my manager to receive the device?

Ben: I'll generate a return label and post pickup/drop instructions here. Shipping via the internal mailroom usually takes 2 business days.

HR Bot: COBRA notice queued for tori@redwood.com within 10 business days after offboard. COBRA enrollment period: 60 days from notice. Benefits termination date: 2026-05-01 23:59 PT. Policy ref: https://redwood.in/policies/offboarding-benefits.

Michael: If you need access extended for shadowing after last day, put the request in this thread and we'll approve up to 72 hours for troubleshooting only. Also remember to scrub any personal credentials from home directory before device return.

Tori: Please keep keycard active through 2026-05-02 09:00 so I can do the recorded KT in person. I'll upload a 10-15min Loom of the architecture flow to the runbook.

Alexis: Got it. I'll record the session and take notes in the runbook.

Ben: Offboard task created: https://tasks.redwood.com/board/ops/Offboard-3150000000. Will update with shipping label and final checklist.

Tori: Thanks everyone. Appreciate the support.
